newsitem.title: USA: Zoltek pushing plans for carbon fibers.
newsitem.headline: Zoltek pushing plans for carbon fibers.

text.p: Zoltek Cos Inc in its annual report said the company is pushing to step up the pace in its plan to commercialize carbon fiber.
The company said it is focusing on development of new applications in 10 primary areas, ranging from sporting goods and automotive to construction and marine.

Chairman Zsolt Rumy said in the report, "We now have an early defined plan for eliminating bottlenecks and achieving three key objectives by 2000." Rumy said Zoltek is committed to establishing a price of $5 per pound for substantial users and "we are taking steps to assure that we maintain our profit margins as we reduce prices."
Zoltek is an applied technology and materials company primarily focused on the low cost manufacturing and application of carbon fibers used as a reinforcement material in composites.
